title: fix(scoring-pending-count): derive the idle scoring fragment from the database

req_statements.R1: The `seekandemploy.repository` module shall expose `count_unscored_matches` with the signature `count_unscored_matches(session: Session) -> int`.
req_statements.R2: WHEN the database contains `n` `Match` rows whose `score` is NULL, `count_unscored_matches` shall return `n`.  ---  ## Fragment running state
req_statements.R3: WHILE the store snapshot is present with `running=True` and `total > 0`, the `GET /scoring/progress` fragment shall contain the HTML `<progress>` element with `value="{done}"` and `max="{total}"` and the localized running text.
req_statements.R4: WHILE the store snapshot has `running=True`, the system shall not issue the unscored-match count query when rendering `GET /scoring/progress`.  ---  ## Fragment idle state
req_statements.R5: WHEN the store snapshot is absent and the database contains at least one `Match` row whose `score` is NULL, the fragment shall contain the localized pending text carrying the number of unscored matches.
req_statements.R6: WHEN the store snapshot is absent and the database contains no `Match` row whose `score` is NULL, the fragment shall contain the localized up-to-date text.
req_statements.R7: WHEN the store snapshot has `running=False` and the database contains at least one `Match` row whose `score` is NULL, the fragment shall contain the localized pending text carrying the number of unscored matches.
req_statements.R8: WHEN the store snapshot has `running=False` and the database contains no `Match` row whose `score` is NULL, the fragment shall contain the localized up-to-date text.
req_statements.R9: WHEN the store snapshot has `running=False`, the fragment shall append the localized last-pass summary — carrying the snapshot's scored count, the snapshot's failed-profile count, and the database-derived pending count — after the pending or up-to-date text, on the same line.
req_statements.R10: WHILE no scoring pass is running (the store snapshot is absent or has `running=False`), the pending count displayed by the fragment shall equal the number of `Match` rows whose `score` is NULL in the database.
req_statements.R11: WHILE no scoring pass is running, the fragment shall contain no `<progress>` element.
req_statements.R12: WHEN the store snapshot is absent, the fragment shall contain no last-pass summary.  ---  ## Localized strings
req_statements.R13: The system shall define the `scoring_progress_pending` and `scoring_progress_up_to_date` strings in both the English and the Spanish catalog.
req_statements.R14: The `scoring_progress_pending` string shall carry the `{pending}` placeholder in both the English and the Spanish catalog.
req_statements.R15: The idle fragment shall be rendered in the locale resolved for the request.
req_statements.R16: The system shall keep the existing scoring-progress strings (`scoring_progress_running`, `scoring_progress_summary`, `scoring_progress_nothing`) defined in both the English and the Spanish catalog.  ---  ## Schema stability
req_statements.R17: The system shall not add a database migration or schema change for this feature.
